name: Daylight
author: Aura Shell
description: A light room: a cool paper ground, ink text, an indigo accent, 28px corners and real glass at 18px blur. The light counterpart to Aura, and the proof that the focus logic is structural - the ring is the theme's ink rather than white, and every other signal is unchanged. Ships tokens and three folder silhouettes, and no CSS whatsoever.
